title: Parking Sensor
intro: Measure distance with sound waves, then beep faster and light up as something gets closer.

steps.title: Measure the distance
steps.text:
The ultrasonic sensor works like a bat: it sends a squeak too high for us to hear, and times how long the echo takes to come back. A longer time means something further away.

The code is ready: the `measureCm()` function does the measuring. **Your task:** Run it, open the **Serial Monitor**, and move your hand towards the sensor. (In the simulator, drag the distance slider.)
hints: Hold your hand in front of the two round "eyes" of the sensor.
In the simulator, the slider beside the sensor sets the distance.
The number should get smaller as your hand gets closer.

checks.label: The distance changes when I move my hand

steps.success: Your board can measure distance with sound! Bats, dolphins and submarines do it this way too.

steps.title: Traffic-light distance
steps.text:
Now the three LEDs show how close something is: green when it's far, yellow when it's getting close, red when it's too close.

**Your task:** fill in the blanks so it's green over 50 cm, yellow over 20 cm, and red closer than that.
hints: `else if` is only checked when the `if` before it was false.

checks.label: The lights change as my hand gets closer

steps.success: Green, yellow, red. Your code chooses between three paths: that's branching.

steps.title: Beeping
steps.text:
Real parking sensors beep faster as you get closer. The gap between beeps can be the distance times 10 milliseconds: 80 cm means 800 ms between beeps, 10 cm means 100 ms.

**Your task:** fill in the blank so the gap gets shorter as something gets closer.
hints: The gap should get smaller when `cm` gets smaller.

checks.label: The beeps get faster as my hand gets closer

steps.success: Beep... beep.. beep.beep! Sound helps drivers who can't look at a screen.

steps.title: The whole parking sensor
steps.text: **Goal:** put it all together: the lights show the distance *and* the buzzer beeps faster as something gets closer.
hints: You already have `showDistance()`. Call it in `loop()` with the distance.
Copy the beeping code from the last step into `loop()`.
Measure once, then use `cm` for both the lights and the beeps.

checks.label: The red light comes on up close
Lights and beeps both change as I get closer

steps.success: A real parking sensor! The ones in cars use the same ultrasonic sensors.

outro: Your parking sensor measures distance with sound, like a bat. You timed an echo with **pulseIn**, worked out centimetres, and made decisions with **if / else if**.
stretch: Make the beeps a continuous tone when something is closer than 5 cm.
Smooth out jumpy readings: average the last 5 measurements.
Show a bar of # characters in the Serial Monitor, longer when something is closer.
